The '''Knight's Helmet''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained as a reward from [[Gil]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after completing the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] of killing 50 [[Pepper Rex]]es. After that, it can be purchased from [[Marlon]] for {{Price|20000}}.
